instrument: GPM IMERG Late Run v07, daily, 0.1 degree
floor_note: Cells whose window total is below the floor are omitted from 'cells'. They are not zero, they are below the drawing floor.
instrument_caveat: IMERG over-reads light rain and under-reads heavy rain on the same field on the same day. It is a daily total, so rain that falls in a few violent hours can flood without moving it.
